starter_questions: How can I try the included dilution series?
What should my Markdown procedure include?
Why did the last procedure adapt or stop?

setup_guide.introduction: Try the included dilution-series sample to watch a simulated procedure and see how its checks are recorded. You can also bring your own Markdown procedure.

sample.title: Synthetic dilution series with two shortage recoveries
sample.description: Run the bundled dilution series and see how the simulation handles two supply shortages.
sample.expected_output: A simulated deck, volume checks and a replay of the procedure.

real.introduction: Use your own Markdown procedure in the simulator.

fields.label: Lab procedure
fields.description: Paste Markdown with explicit starting volumes, numbered steps and final goals. Clear the procedure file when using text.

fields.label: Procedure file
fields.description: Select a .md file instead of pasting text.

fields.label: Saved explanation preferences
fields.description: Managed in Memory. Changes Chat wording; revise the Markdown and start a new run to change the procedure.

run_guidance.on_start: I’ll turn the procedure into a simulation plan so you can follow the steps and see how exceptions are handled.
run_guidance.web_ui_ready: Open Web lab to see the current phase. As simulated steps appear, compare a movement on the deck with its entry in the event stream.
run_guidance.output_ready: Open report.md in the output folder to review the simulation checks and any steps that need attention.

web_ui.title: Web lab
web_ui.description: Watch the simulated equipment operate in 3D, then review the saved replay.
